description: This file implements the multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup and management UI for the Notesnook app, including MFA method selection, setup steps, recovery codes, and success confirmation screens.

classes.name: MFASheet
classes.description: Main component managing MFA setup flow, including method selection, setup, recovery codes, and success confirmation.

classes.name: MFASuccess
classes.description: Component displaying success message after MFA setup, with options to add secondary MFA method.

classes.name: MFARecoveryCodes
classes.description: Component displaying and managing MFA recovery codes, with options to copy or save to file.

classes.name: MFASetup
classes.description: Component handling MFA setup process for different methods (app, SMS, email), including code verification and sending.

classes.name: MFAMethodsPickerStep
classes.description: Component for selecting MFA method, with feature availability checks and UI for options.

methods.name: MFASheet.present
methods.description: Function to present the MFA setup sheet modally.

methods.name: MFARecoveryCodes.present
methods.description: Function to present recovery codes sheet for a specific MFA method.
